## Image generation set

`project` is an image-set workspace for generating, selecting, upscaling, editing, and delivering still image series.

### Layout

- `refs/`: Reference images supplied by the user. Read-only, never modify.
- `prompts/`: One .md per series: positive, negative, seed, settings.
- `workflows/`: ComfyUI workflow .json files, versioned by filename; retired ones in archive/.
- `models/`: Notes only: name, source URL, hash, trigger words.
- `outputs/`: Everything generated: raw, selects, upscales, edits (inpaint/retouch), finals.
- `contact-sheets/`: Comparison grids for reviewing batches. Disposable, safe to regenerate.
- `logs/`: Run logs and queue dumps. Ignored by Git and disposable.
- Anything that fits no folder above: ask where it goes; do not invent a new top-level folder.

### Rules

- Each folder's purpose is in `FOLDERS.md`; read it before adding a file.
- New generations go in `outputs/raw/YYYY-MM-DD/` and nowhere else.
- Never write, rename or delete anything in `refs/`.
- Copy from `outputs/raw/` to `outputs/selects/`; do not move, and do not rename.
- An upscale in `outputs/upscales/` keeps the select's filename plus `_2x` or `_4x`.
- Every select gets a line in `prompts/<series>.md`: prompt, seed, model, workflow file.
- A changed workflow in `workflows/` is saved as a new file (`name_v02.json`); never overwrite one.
- Never put model weights in this repo; record them in `models/*.md` (`models/checkpoints.md`, `models/loras.md`, `models/embeddings.md`).
- Files enter `outputs/finals/` only after the user approves them.
- Deleting anything outside `outputs/raw/`, `contact-sheets/` or `logs/` needs approval.
- Run `git lfs install` once before the first commit.
<!-- kit:image-set end -->
